item.title: National Health Fund commits to carrying out improvement work on health infrastructure in St. Mary
item.description: The National Health Fund (NHF) has committed to continue carrying out significant work to improve health infrastructure in St. Mary, as well as supporting the pharmaceutical needs of residents.Institutional Benefits Manager at the NHF, Collie Smith, provided an overview of the Fund's work in St. Mary at the opening of the Belfield Community Health Centre yesterday. The post National Health Fund commits to carrying out improvement work on health infrastructure in St. Mary appeared first on IRIE F

item.title: Opposition demands that Gov’t take immediate steps to address logistics crisis at Port of Kingston
item.description: According to Spokesman on Trade, Investment and Global Logistics, Anthony Hylton, there have been growing complaints by small business operators, individuals and relief organisations about being hit with extraordinary delays in clearing containers from the port, as well as increased costs for demurrage and related charges. item.title: Toddler killed, 8 y/o and man wounded in Denham Town; MP offers reward for information
item.description: A three-year-old boy is dead and 2 others including an 8-year-old are nursing gunshot wounds following an attack along Nelson Street in Denham Town, Kingston this morning. The identity of the toddler has not been released. The post Toddler killed, 8 y/o and man wounded in Denham Town; MP offers reward for information appeared first on IRIE FM.

item.title: May Pen to Williamsfield Highway toll plazas projected to add US$10M to TJH’s revenue
item.description: The two toll plazas along the recently opened May Pen to Williamsfield Leg of Highway 2000, are projected to add 10 million u-s dollars to the revenue of Trans-Jamaica Highway Limited (TJH). Chief Operating Officer, Colin Murray, made the declaration during an investor briefing at the Pegasus Hotel yesterday. item.title: 22 y/o Clarendon man killed in Portland crash
item.description: Police have identified the 22-year-old man who died as a result of injuries sustained in a crash along the Hope Bay Main Road in Portland this morning. Dead is D’Angelo Dixon of Fairburn, James Hill, Clarendon. The post 22 y/o Clarendon man killed in Portland crash appeared first on IRIE FM.

item.title: Approximately 500 pounds of ganja seized in St. Thomas
item.description: Approximately 500 pounds of ganja were seized during a police operation in South Haven Yallahs, St. Thomas, yesterday. Reports are that at about 2:30pm officers acting on intelligence carried out an operation at an abandoned house in the community. item.title: “Jubby” and “Romie” named as POIs in murder of 3 y/o and wounding of 2 others in Denham Town
item.description: The police have named 2 persons of interest in relation to the murder of three year old Jase Pinnock and the wounding of 2 of his relatives during a gun attack along Nelson Street in Denham Town, Kingston this morning. Those being sought are known as Jubby and Romie, who lawmen allege are members of the Scream Corner gang. item.title: CPFSA condemns killing of child in Denham Town
item.description: The Child Protection and Family Services Agency (CPFSA) has joined in condemning the killing of 3 year old Jayce Pinnock as well as the wounding of his brother and father in Denham Town, Kingston this morning. The post CPFSA condemns killing of child in Denham Town appeared first on IRIE FM.

item.title: Appeal made for donations to support airlift of Westmoreland burn victim to the USA for treatment
item.description: Efforts are being made by local organisation Burn Foundation of Jamaica / Crisis Support Charity to airlift the Westmoreland woman who was doused in gasoline and set on fire to the United States of America for treatment.
